text:
Jonathan Marchessault came to Nashville as a Conn Smythe winner, and at 35 his game has narrowed to one place: the power play. All five of his points this season (2 goals, 3 assists in 14 games) came with the man advantage. At five on five the Predators have had 32.6% of the expected goals with him on the ice (expected goals measure the quality of chances), 17.7 points worse than when he sits.

He hasn't played since Oct 31; RotoWire and CBS Sports have had him out with an injury through every game of November, and Nashville has won all of them. The finishing has been cold too, 6.5% shooting against an 11.3% midpoint in our range, so a return should bring a few more goals. Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level last season, with chances against climbing when he was out there. The question when he's back is where he fits on a team that found a rhythm without him.
headline: Marchessault's points have all come on the power play
